dielectric_gaps.material: bare FR4 core without copper faces

six_primary.rationale: One additional routing layer versus four-layer S/G/S/S, with a close ground reference for every signal layer. The central signal pair is separated by more than eleven times its respective 0.1mm ground distance.
six_primary.representation_gate: Separate central prepreg/core/prepreg thicknesses and Dk now survive the derivative KiCad10 roundtrip and ordered comparison. Bare addsublayer tokens share one container type. No homogeneous averaging was used. Quilter import remains unverified.
six_primary.mechanical_limit: Nominal 1.6mm selection is not exact 1.6mm construction. This is an isolated study; final thickness/tolerance, service fit and contact/mount stack need mechanical rebinding before manufacture.

eight_fallback.rationale: Same four routing layers and close references, with additional ground shielding between the internal signals. Not two more routing layers than the six-primary option.
activation_conditions: Six-primary composite dielectric cannot be represented faithfully by native/imported tools.
Six-primary returned routing demonstrates a material reference/plane limitation, rather than assuming all collision reports are solved by layer count.
eight_fallback.status: Actual supplier alternative identified; no native input or cloud draft constructed.
